floorPlans.introduction: Explore the detached villas, semi-detached villas and four townhouse layouts in the original District 11 Opal Gardens brochure.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose an Opal Gardens home type
floorPlans.note: The original brochure prints a total built-up area for each layout. Plot shape, landscaping and pool configurations are illustrative. Confirm the signed plan for your plot.

review.images: Eight native project renderings from the original Meydan brochure hosted by Nakheel. The PDF contains an express written consent notice covering images, trademarks and copyright. Resolve distribution permission before Git handoff or publication.
review.location: Brochure page 5 provides the regional diagram. The corporate page supplies all five approximate travel times and links to the development marker, which is distinct from a plot or gate.
review.floorPlans: All nine complete layout sheets from the official 40-page brochure. Townhouse types B and C have four bedrooms according to the visible headings and room labels. The hidden PDF text incorrectly describes them as three-bedroom. Areas follow the visible tables, including 8,453.12 sq ft for the six-bedroom villa.

unavailable: Signed plot-specific plans and gate coordinates.
Express permission to distribute the published brochure or reproductions.
